leagues.name: Sudan Premier League
leagues.note: HONEST STATUS UPDATE, checked as instructed: the domestic Sudan Premier League has PARTIALLY RESUMED for 2025-26, not fully restarted as before the civil war. The Sudanese Football Association restructured it as a much-expanded, regionalised competition (reported as '50 clubs' across 'four safe states', its 29th edition) rather than the pre-war single national tier. 10 clubs above were individually named across SFA and news coverage of this 2025-26 competition. However, sources are contradictory about the country's traditional giants: some report Al-Hilal SC, Al-Merrikh SC and Al-Ahli Wad Madani (the flagship club, distinct from the smaller Al-Ahli Wad Madani in this league's roster) relocated to play in Rwanda's Premier League for continental purposes, while other 2026 news coverage describes an Al-Hilal vs Al-Merrikh Sudan Premier League 2025-26 title race decided by an Appeals Committee (Al-Hilal stripped of the title, Al-Merrikh awarded it) -- these two accounts could not be reconciled in this session, so neither Al-Hilal SC nor Al-Merrikh SC (the top-flight giants) were added to the clubs list to avoid conflating them with the smaller same-named regional sides above. Given the reconstituted/regionalised nature of the competition and the unresolved contradiction, verified is left false. Re-check next season once the competition's post-war structure has settled.
